topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When my sibling and I inherited our grandmother’s house, it felt like a chapter from her life was passing into our hands. We took our time, walking through each room, remembering the stories she’d shared about the house and the family history it held. The transition was smooth, perhaps because we both understood the value of what we’d received wasn’t just the physical property, but the legacy and memories that came with it. We decided to make changes slowly, respecting the house’s history while making it a part of our own lives. It’s a process, filled with small, thoughtful decisions, each one a step towards honoring her memory in our own way.
